Name: SaveSaver
Author: secsky3
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b]SaveSaver[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Prevent Save-Load Crashes, Heal Broken Trees & Sanitize Orphaned Mod Data[/i][/size]

[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Why SaveSaver?[/b][/size]
Have you ever experienced your game [b]crashing to desktop or freezing infinitely[/b] when trying to load a long-played save after uninstalling a mod, updating an expansion, or cleaning up your mod list?

In Stardew Valley 1.6+, when mods containing custom C# classes (items, equipment, buildings) or custom locations are removed, orphaned data tags remain inside your save file XML. The vanilla game deserializer throws a fatal [b]InvalidOperationException[/b] or [b]NullReferenceException[/b] and refuses to open your farm.

[b]SaveSaver[/b] is an intelligent, automated save file protector and integrity sanitizer. It intercepts your save file at the XML stream level [b]before[/b] the vanilla deserializer touches it, safely replacing orphaned mod types with vanilla items and rescuing stranded players, all while keeping automatic timestamped backups!

[line]

[size=5][b]🌟 Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]🛡️ Zero-Crash Save Loading[/b]: Safely neutralizes unregistered C# classes ([font=Courier New]xsi:type[/font]) before vanilla deserialization, preventing game-closing crashes.[/*]
[*][b]🌲 Tree Healing (Fix for SVE / Custom Trees)[/b]: Automatically detects broken mod trees (such as old SVE Fir/Birch trees) that cause red "X" errors in Lookup Anything or show a forbidden cursor. Converts them into healthy, fully-grown vanilla Oak/Pine trees ready for tapping and chopping![/*]
[*][b]📦 ErrorItem Auto-Converter[/b]: Converts ugly [font=Courier New](O)ErrorItem[/font] cluttering your inventory, chests, and fridge into safe vanilla items (default: Stone, customizable via config).[/*]
[*][b]🗺️ Stranded Player Rescue & Map Cleanup[/b]: If you saved your game inside a custom mod map that has since been uninstalled, SaveSaver safely warps your farmer back to your FarmHouse bed and cleans ghost map nodes from your save.[/*]
[*][b]📋 In-Game Interactive Recovery Dialog[/b]: When corruptions are neutralized, an in-game UI displays exact details of what was cleaned, allowing you to permanently clean the save with one click or keep it temporary for the session.[/*]
[*][b]💾 Automatic Safety Backup[/b]: Every time a disk clean or save sanitization occurs, an untampered timestamped backup is saved in [font=Courier New]Mods/SaveSaver/Backups/[/font].[/*]
[*][b]🌐 Full i18n Localization[/b]: Supports English and Korean out-of-the-box.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]💻 Console Commands[/b][/size]
You can open the SMAPI console anytime to run diagnosis or manual fixes:
[list]
[*][b]savesaver_scan[/b] : Scans all save folders in your Stardew Valley saves directory and reports missing mod types or corrupted entries.[/*]
[*][b]savesaver_clean [save_folder_name][/b] : Permanently cleans the specified save file (or type [font=Courier New]all[/font] to clean all saves) with verified automatic backups.[/*]
[*][b]savesaver_convert_trees[/b] : Scans all loaded locations and instantly heals all broken/invalid mod trees into mature vanilla trees.[/*]
[*][b]savesaver_convert_errors[/b] : Scans inventory, chests, and fridges, converting all ErrorItems into safe vanilla items.[/*]
[*][b]savesaver_purge_errors[/b] : Deletes all ErrorItems from inventory and nearby chests.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]📥 Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (v4.0.0 or higher, Stardew Valley 1.6+).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and place the [b]SaveSaver[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🤝 Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]: Fully compatible with 1.6.0 through 1.6.15+ (Single-player and Multiplayer).[/*]
[*][b]Expansion Mods[/b]: Works seamlessly alongside Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, and any custom item mods.[/*]
[*][b]Lookup Anything[/b]: Resolves Lookup Anything inspection crashes on uninstalled mod trees.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]🇰🇷 한국어 안내[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]모드 개요[/b]: 대확장 모드(SVE), 리지사이드, 각종 아이템 모드를 삭제하거나 업데이트한 후 세이브를 불러올 때 게임이 튕기거나 멈추는 현상을 원천 차단하는 세이브 복구 및 무결성 정제 모드입니다.[/*]
[*][b]크래시 방어[/b]: 세이브 역직렬화 직전 XML 스트림 단계에서 존재하지 않는 모드 C# 클래스를 감지하여 바닐라 돌로 안전 치환하므로 튕김 없이 세이브를 불러올 수 있습니다.[/*]
[*][b]고장 난 모드 나무 복구[/b]: SVE 등 삭제된 모드의 전나무/자작나무가 맵에 남아 룩업 애니띵 에러를 뿜거나 도끼질이 불가능하던 현상을 바닐라 성목(소나무/참나무)으로 즉시 정상화합니다.[/*]
[*][b]고립된 플레이어 구조[/b]: 삭제된 모드 맵에서 저장하고 모드를 지웠더라도 농가 침대로 안전하게 이동시켜 세이브가 열리지 않는 문제를 해결합니다.[/*]
[*][b]인게임 복구 메뉴 및 안전 장치[/b]:
  - 게임 접속 시 오염 항목이 정제되면 상세 안내창이 나타나 영구 정제 여부를 결정할 수 있습니다.
  - [b]주의사항 안내[/b]: 최근 모드를 변경하거나 삭제한 적이 없다면 모드 설정을 먼저 확인하실 수 있도록 안내합니다.
  - [b]자동 백업[/b]: 영구 제거를 선택해도 원본 세이브 파일이 [font=Courier New]SaveSaver/Backups/[/font] 폴더에 자동 백업되므로 안심하고 사용하실 수 있습니다.[/*]
[/list]
